pages.text: The Silk Touch Upgrade enables silk touch functionality in the Destructor, allowing it to mine blocks without breaking them.
Features:$(li)Enables silk touch mining$(li)Works in Destructors$(li)Preserves block states$(li)Increases power consumption
To use the Silk Touch Upgrade:$(li)Right-click on a Destructor$(li)Insert the upgrade into an upgrade slot$(li)Destructor will now mine blocks with silk touch$(li)Increases power consumption
